Someone, she thought, should know.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市还没有醒来，却也并未真正入睡。街灯将湿漉漉的路面染成橙黄色，出租车偶尔划过，像鱼游过深水。便利店的玻璃门透出冷白的光，收银员靠在柜台上，眼神空洞。环卫工人已经出现了，橙色的背心在暗处格外显眼，扫帚划过地面发出沙沙的声响，是这个城市最早的语言。远处有工地的机械声，低沉而持续，像城市的心跳。楼上某扇窗亮着，说不清是谁还未睡去，还是谁已早早醒来。这个时刻属于少数人，悄悄地，诚实地。", "w03": "• Recursion means a function that calls itself to solve a smaller version of the same problem, like looking up a word in a dictionary and finding the definition uses another word you need to look up.\n• Every recursive function needs a stopping point called the base case, so it does not call itself forever — like finally finding a word whose definition you already know.\n• The computer stacks up each call and waits for the smaller problem to finish before it can finish the bigger one, the way you stack cups inside each other and must take them out in reverse order."}
